note: Hahns Peak/Bears Ears RD (Routt NF): aspen and spruce-fir campground at ~8,300 ft on lower Buffalo Pass Rd (CR 38), about 8 mi NE of Steamboat Springs near Strawberry Park Hot Springs, beside the busy Dry Lake Trailhead. Rebuilt and expanded in 2024 from 8 sites; reopened 2025. The road is good to the campground (the rough stretch is beyond it toward Buffalo Pass). 'Dry Lake' is an 8-inch-deep pond that dries up by early summer. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 10168487 + its per-site catalog: confirmed reservable with some first-come sites, vault toilets, no potable water, $26 (2026; doubles $50). Changed sites 23 -> 22 (recreation.gov count and catalog) and added 50-92 ft lengths with pull-throughs; booking window 14 days (not the federal 180), reservation season June 26 - Sept 14, first-come after. Season: removed the calendar-derived 'closes 09-14' (that is the end of reservations; the FS says open to mid-October). Pin ~110 m from the site centroid. Note trimmed.

The FS page links an approved 'fee change'; the Forest's fee-change page does not give a new Dry Lake rate, and recreation.gov still charges $26 for 2026-2027.
